03-09-2017 11:03 am को "Vikram Rawat" <vikram...@gmail.com> ने लिखा:
Its been 2 days I am trying to make a WebApp where I can insert data into a PostgresDB.
I am Unable to run this code and I have no idea why is it happening. I have attached the Project file. It's not hard for you but I am not a coder.

can anybody please spot the error

please help me out I have watched all the tutorials available on modules but I didn't understood how it can be done.
 

You don't need to have PostgreSQL on your system to run it. You just need to read the CODE. It is very simple. With 2 deactivated textboxes and nothing else.


this is the MAIN APP

################################################################################################
################################################################################################
################################################################################################
# LodedLibraries ----------------------------------------------------------
library(shiny)
library(shinyBS)
library(shinyjs)
library(shinydashboard)
library(DBI)
library(magrittr)
library(data.table)
library(pool)
library(miniUI)
library(RPostgreSQL)
source('Login.R')
source('Supplier/Supplier.R')

LoginValue<-Gadgetlogin()


# GraphicalInterface ------------------------------------------------------

ui<-dashboardPage(
    dashboardHeader(),
    dashboardSidebar(),
    dashboardBody(
        supplierUi('test')
    )
)

# ServerSide --------------------------------------------------------------


server<-function(input,output,session){
    

PSQLcon<-reactive({
        dbPool(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                              user=LoginValue[1],
                              password=LoginValue[2],
                              dbname='RajveerCorp')
        })
        
    
callModule(supplierServe,PSQLcon())

        
    
}

# RunApp ------------------------------------------------------------------

shinyApp(ui,server)

################################################################################################
##########This is the Modulerized Part################################################################
################################################################################################

# library -----------------------------------------------------------------

library(shiny)
library(shinyBS)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinyjs)
library(flexdashboard)
library(DBI)
library(pool)

# ModuleUi ----------------------------------------------------------------

supplierUi<-function(id){
    ns<-NS(id)
    
    tagList(useShinyjs(),
            disabled(textInput(ns('time'),'Current Time',value=Sys.time())),
            uiOutput(ns('supplierIdOut'))
            )
}

# ModuleServer ------------------------------------------------------------

supplierServe<-function(input,output,session,connstring){
    
    supplierId<-reactive({
        ns<-session$ns
        num<-dbGetQuery(connstring(),'select max(Supplierid) from supplier.supplier')
        if(is.na(num))(1)else(num+1)
        })
    output$supplierIdOut<-renderUI({
        ns<-session$ns
        disabled(textInput(ns('supplierId'),'Supplier ID',value=supplierId()))
        })
    

}
################################################################################################
##########This is the Modulerized Part################################################################
################################################################################################


Please please please HELP me out. none of the online tutorials are good enough to be understood properly.
